lines: OpenMontage turns your AI assistant into a full video production studio with 12 pipelines.
You tell your AI what to make, then an agent reads the pipeline manifest.
Say 'Make a 60-second Adam-Curtis-style archival collage about 1950s consumer optimism.' The agent creates that specific video.
Every tool selection runs through a 7-dimension scoring engine.
Quality gates enforce your sign-off on script, assets, and the final publish.
Add API keys for 20+ video providers or use free tools like NASA footage.
It uses the GNU AGPLv3 license.
Start with git clone OpenMontage, then run make setup.
Send this to someone building their first video project today.
Close with a short punchline that names OpenMontage.
